_comment: TDD M4 read slice: Muse catalog projects cached inventory; unknown limits fall back to 128000/16384; known effort values become variants with default high; unknown effort stays variant-free. RED on baseline (no muse-code route).
name: m4_read_api_musecode_models
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning]
supported = true

[capabilities.overrides."m-a".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "high"]

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
